_comment: Per-machine training backends (copy to backends.json; gitignored).
Shallow-merged over the built-in defaults in pipeline/backends.py — you only
need to set keys that differ on THIS machine. Adding a trainer is a config
entry here, not a code change. Top-level keys starting with '_' are ignored.
── interpreter (Python backends), most portable first ──
1. "python": absolute path (set this if the env isn't a standard conda env)
2. $CONDA_ROOT/envs/<conda_env>/bin/python
3. <envs>/<conda_env>/bin/python derived from the panel's own sys.prefix
"repo" is relative to the Recon Studio repo dir unless absolute. The command run
is:  <env-python> -u <train_script> <train_args>   with cwd = <repo>.
── train_args / mesh_args templates (str.format placeholders) ──
{scene}  COLMAP scene the panel prepares      {out}   model output dir
{args}   the params[] below, assembled to flags   {extra}  free-text escape hatch
Python default:  -s {scene} -m {out} {args} {extra}
Binary default:  -d {scene} -o {out} {args} {extra}
── params[] schema (rendered as form fields; same schema for mesh_params) ──
key   value key returned by the form (required)
flag  CLI flag emitted, e.g. --iterations (required)
type  int | float | str | bool | select        (select needs "options": [...])
default / label / hint / placeholder / group   UI only
A bool emits just its flag when truthy; non-bools emit "flag value" when non-empty.
Add "invert": true for "on by default, the flag DISABLES it" CLIs (e.g. LichtFeld
--no-cpu-cache): the checkbox reads as the feature ON and the flag is emitted only
when UNchecked. See cpu_cache / fs_cache below.
── compiled (non-Python) trainers ──
"launch": "binary" + "exec": path to the built executable (relative to the panel
repo or absolute, ~ expanded). The panel runs it directly — no conda/torch — and
readiness just checks the file is executable. params[] become CLI flags. If the
binary can't find its shared libs, set LD_LIBRARY_PATH in local.env. Binary backends
can't mesh, but 去背 still works (downloads a cleaned cloud).
── mesh extraction ──
A backend offers the Mesh tab ONLY if it declares "mesh_args" (+ optional
"mesh_script" / "mesh_params"). GS-2M does (render.py --extract_mesh); gsplat and
the LichtFeld binaries below omit it, so the Mesh tab won't list them.
── real-size (mm) ──
Set "marker_defaults" (physical ChArUco board geometry) to enable the Mesh tab's
marker-scale option. Scaling scripts live in the panel's tools/ and run in THIS
backend's env (needs opencv-contrib-python / open3d / plyfile / scipy).
_lichtfeld_note: lichtfeld-mrnf is now BUILT-IN (pipeline/backends.py), so most
machines need NO entry here at all — the default exec path ../LichtFeld-Studio/
build/LichtFeld-Studio just works when the repo is a sibling of reconstudio/.
Only add an override below if this machine's build lives somewhere else; you
do NOT need to re-list "params" (shallow merge is per top-level backend key,
so overriding "exec" alone keeps every built-in param, including any new ones
added later without touching this file).
